title: Retention/Promotion Policy (v1)
description: Schema for library/policies/<policy_id>.json. Each policy applies at exactly one scope level. When multiple policies could apply to the same data, precedence is fixed and total: asset > role > system > source > global (most specific wins; ties are not possible because scope+selector is unique per level). Presentation/profile selection never silently promotes bytes — promotion always requires the promote-on-approval outcome plus an explicit approval step.

scope.description: Precedence order (highest to lowest): asset > role > system > source > global. "global" has no selector; every other level requires one.

selector.description: Value the level applies to: source id, system id, asset role, or asset sha256. Omitted only when level == "global".

promotion.description: Only meaningful when retention.outcome == "promote-on-approval". Promotion is always an explicit, auditable step — never implied by selecting an asset for presentation.
